domain-information: An applicant submits an application containing a CV to the employment agency to be considered for job opportunities.
An applicant updates their CV when they gain new skills or work experience.
An applicant requests career guidance meeting with an agent.
An applicant attends an interview arranged by the agent with a potential employer.
An applicant receives feedback from the agent after an unsuccessful interview.
An agent reviews applications by applicants to identify suitable matches.
An agent sets the submission status of an application as shortlisted.
An agent sends a candidate recommendation containing an application to employers.
An agent schedules interviews between applicants and employers.
An agent analyses candidate requests from employers to match them with applicants.
An employer sends candidate requests with job requirements to the employment agency.
An employer reviews applications provided by the agent to select potential applicants.
An employer interviews applicants recommended by the agency.
An employer provides feedback to the agent about the candidate.
An employment agency collects application records to build a talent pool.
An employment agency maintains records of employers candidate requests.
An agent tracks the outcomes of interviews to improve future matches.

domain objects.name: Applicant
domain objects.description: A person seeking employment through the agency, often represented by their CV.

domain objects.name: CV
domain objects.description: A document that captures an applicant’s skills, education, and work experience.

domain objects.name: Application
domain objects.description: A formal submission by an applicant for a job, tracked by its status and linked to a CV.

domain objects.name: Submission Status
domain objects.description: The current state of an application, such as pending, accepted, or rejected.

domain objects.name: Agent
domain objects.description: A staff member at the employment agency who supports applicants and employers.

domain objects.name: Career Guidance Meeting
domain objects.description: A session between an agent and applicant to discuss career options and improve job readiness.

domain objects.name: Interview
domain objects.description: A meeting between an applicant and employer to assess suitability, with an outcome recorded.

domain objects.name: Employer
domain objects.description: An organization seeking candidates to fill job positions.

domain objects.name: Outcome
domain objects.description: The result of an interview, such as successful or unsuccessful.

domain objects.name: Interview Feedback
domain objects.description: Comments provided after an interview to help the applicant improve.

domain objects.name: Candidate Recommendation
domain objects.description: A suggestion made by an agent to an employer, based on an application.

domain objects.name: Candidate Request
domain objects.description: A request from an employer to the agency for candidates, defined by job requirements.

domain objects.name: Job Requirements
domain objects.description: The qualifications, skills, and experience needed for a role.

domain objects.name: Candidate Feedback
domain objects.description: An employer’s evaluation of a candidate after review or interview.

domain objects.name: Employment Agency
domain objects.description: An organization that connects applicants and employers, managing applications and candidate requests.

associations.description: An Applicant submits and updates an Application.
An Agent reviews and manages Applications.
An Agent conducts a Career Guidance Meeting.
An Applicant attends a Career Guidance Meeting.
An Agent arranges and oversees an Interview.
Candidate Feedback is shared with an Agent.
Interview Feedback is received by an Applicant.
An Agent prepares and sends a Candidate Recommendation.
A Candidate Recommendation is reviewed by an Employer.
An Employer submits a Candidate Request.
An Agent works within an Employment Agency.
